title: Reverse an Array
description:
Write a function that takes an array and reverses it in-place.
Example: [1, 2, 3] → [3, 2, 1]
explanation: Use two-pointer technique: swap elements from start and end.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description: Given an integer array, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
explanation: Use Kadane’s Algorithm: track max‑ending‑here and max‑so‑far.
